NY-2025-S10729.title: Allows drivers to contest license revocations, suspensions, and other penalties based on cases of mistaken identity and require identity verification prior to adverse administrative action
NY-2025-S10729.summary: Require the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish that the record of the adverse action actually matches the person the department has penalized by establishing a three-point match with the licensee rather than just a name match; allows a driver to contest the determination if they believe it is a case of mistaken identity; provides for a stay/removal of any penalty until there is a final determination.
NY-2025-S10729.aiSummary: The bill would make the state motor vehicle agency check that a penalty record really matches the driver before taking action. It would let drivers contest a suspension, revocation, or other penalty if they think it is a case of mistaken identity. Any penalty would be put on hold until a final decision is made.

NY-2025-J2380.title: Mourning the death of Dolores Huerta, pioneering labor leader, civil rights icon, and lifelong advocate for working families, women, and children
NY-2025-J2380.aiSummary: This resolution would mourn the death of Dolores Huerta, a labor leader and civil rights advocate, and honor her work for working families, women, children, and other communities. It would also send a copy of the resolution to her family.

NY-2025-S9197.title: Provides for the incorporation of the New Hartford Volunteer Exempt Firefighters' Benevolent Association

actions.text: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.453

NY-2025-S9197.aiSummary: Creates a not-for-profit group for eligible current and former volunteer members of the New Hartford Fire Department in Oneida County. The group may help injured, disabled, or needy members and their families, keep a meeting place, and run social and recreation activities. It also may receive certain fire insurance tax money for its work, and that part applies to premiums received on or after January 1, 2027.

NY-2025-S10526.title: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county

actions.text: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.624
COMMITTEE DISCHARGED AND COMMITTED TO RULES
REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

NY-2025-S10526.aiSummary: The bill lets Yates County assistant district attorneys, except the first assistant district attorney, live in Monroe County instead of only in Yates or certain nearby counties. It also lets Yates County assistant public defenders live in Monroe County. The change takes effect immediately.

NY-2025-S9890.title: Relates to automatic license plate reader systems
NY-2025-S9890.summary: Prohibits the use of automatic license plate reader systems or captured plate data by government entities except for certain purposes.

actions.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO CONSUMER PROTECTION

NY-2025-S9890.aiSummary: The bill would limit how government agencies can use automatic license plate readers and the plate data they collect. It would allow that use only for certain approved purposes. This would affect government entities that use these systems or handle the data.

NY-2025-S10722.title: Prohibits healthcare non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants
NY-2025-S10722.summary: Prohibits healthcare non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants; authorizes covered healthcare workers to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.
NY-2025-S10722.aiSummary: The bill would ban non-compete deals and some other work limits for healthcare workers. It would also let covered healthcare workers sue an employer or other person in court if they think the rule was broken.
